title: Few, a few (of), little, a little (of)
summary: Отрицательный и положительный оттенок **few / a few** и **little / a little**, различие **fewer / less**, модели с **of** и устойчивые выражения.
ru:
## Два слова — два настроения
Главная тонкость: **few / little** без артикля означают «мало, почти нет» и несут **отрицательную** оценку (этого не хватает). **A few / a little** означают «немного, но есть» и звучат **положительно или нейтрально**.
> He has **few** friends here. — У него здесь почти нет друзей. (он одинок)
> He has **a few** friends here. — У него здесь есть несколько друзей. (всё в порядке)
> There's **little** hope. — Надежды почти нет.
> There's **a little** hope. — Какая-то надежда есть.

Счётные существительные: **few / a few** + множественное число. Неисчисляемые: **little / a little** + существительное в единственном числе.

## Усиление и смягчение
- **very few / very little** — «совсем мало»; **only a few / only a little** — подчёркивает ограниченность без неодобрения; **quite a few / a good few** — «довольно много» (парадокс!): *Quite a few people came* = пришло немало людей.
- **not many / not much** — нейтральная замена в разговорной речи: *Not many people came.* Тогда как **few** звучит более формально и «литературно»: *Few people realise how serious it is.*
- **few, if any** / **little, if any** — «мало, если вообще какие-либо»: *There is little, if any, evidence.*

## fewer и less
По традиции **fewer** употребляют со **счётными** существительными, а **less** — с **неисчисляемыми**: *fewer cars, less traffic.* Но перед **than** с цифрами, обозначающими время, расстояние, деньги и вес, берётся **less**: *less than an hour, less than ten miles, less than £50*. На табличках в магазинах: *10 items or fewer* (строго) — хотя встречается и *less*.

## few of / a little of
Если после слова стоит конкретная группа — нужен определитель и **of**: **few of the students, a few of them, a little of the soup, little of the money**. Без определителя **of** не используется.
> **A few of the** guests left early. — Несколько гостей ушли рано.
> Could I have **a little of** that cheese? — Можно мне немного этого сыра?
> **Little of** the evidence was convincing. — Мало какие из доказательств были убедительны.
- ~~few of people~~ → **few** people / **few of the** people

## the few / the little
С **the** значение меняется: **the few / the little** = «то немногое, что есть», и подчёркивается, что это всё.
> **The little** money I had was spent on rent. — Те немногие деньги, что у меня были, ушли на аренду.
> **The few** people who came enjoyed it. — Те немногие, кто пришёл, остались довольны.

## Формальные модели
**Little** без артикля в начале предложения с пассивом — признак официального стиля: *Little is known about the cause.* **Little** + инверсия: *Little did she know that the meeting had been cancelled.* — Она и не подозревала...
**A little** перед прилагательными и сравнительными формами значит «слегка»: *a little tired, a little better, a little too late.* А вот **a few** так не работает.
- ~~a few better~~ → **a little** better
- ~~little advices~~ → **little advice** (advice неисчисляем)
en:
## Two words, two moods
The key point: **few / little** without an article mean 'hardly any' and carry a **negative** feeling (not enough). **A few / a little** mean 'some, a small amount' and sound **positive or neutral**.
> He has **few** friends here. (he is lonely)
> He has **a few** friends here. (that's fine)
> There's **little** hope.
> There's **a little** hope.

With countable nouns use **few / a few** + plural. With uncountable nouns use **little / a little** + singular noun.

## Strengthening and softening
- **very few / very little** = 'extremely few'; **only a few / only a little** stresses the small amount without criticism; **quite a few / a good few** means 'a fair number' (a surprise!): *Quite a few people came* = plenty of people came.
- **not many / not much** is a neutral, conversational substitute: *Not many people came.* **Few** is more formal and literary: *Few people realise how serious it is.*
- **few, if any** / **little, if any** = 'few or none': *There is little, if any, evidence.*

## fewer and less
Traditionally **fewer** goes with **countable** nouns and **less** with **uncountable** ones: *fewer cars, less traffic.* But before **than** with time, distance, money and weight, **less** is used: *less than an hour, less than ten miles, less than £50*. In shops: *10 items or fewer* (strict usage), though *less* is also heard.

## few of / a little of
When a specific group follows, we need a determiner and **of**: **few of the students, a few of them, a little of the soup, little of the money**. Without a determiner, no **of**.
> **A few of the** guests left early.
> Could I have **a little of** that cheese?
> **Little of** the evidence was convincing.
- ~~few of people~~ → **few** people / **few of the** people

## the few / the little
With **the**, the meaning changes: **the few / the little** = 'what little there is', stressing that it is all.
> **The little** money I had was spent on rent.
> **The few** people who came enjoyed it.

## Formal patterns
**Little** at the start of a passive sentence marks formal style: *Little is known about the cause.* **Little** + inversion: *Little did she know that the meeting had been cancelled.*
**A little** before adjectives and comparatives means 'slightly': *a little tired, a little better, a little too late.* **A few** doesn't work this way.
- ~~a few better~~ → **a little** better
- ~~little advices~~ → **little advice** (advice is uncountable)
structure:
## Форма → значение → пример
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **few** + мн. число | почти нет (минус) | **Few** people agreed. |
| **a few** + мн. число | несколько (нейтрально) | **A few** people agreed. |
| **little** + неисчисл. | почти нет (минус) | **Little** time remained. |
| **a little** + неисчисл. | немного (нейтрально) | **A little** time remained. |
| **quite a few** | немало | **Quite a few** objected. |
| **the few / the little** | то немногое, что есть | **The little** I know... |
| **a little** + прил./сравн. | слегка | **a little** cooler |

## fewer / less
| Счётное | Неисчисляемое | Исключение |
|---|---|---|
| **fewer** cars | **less** traffic | **less** than an hour / £50 / ten miles |

## Формулы
> **few / a few / little / a little** + of + the / these / my / them
> **Little** + be + причастие II (формальный стиль)
> **Little did** + подлежащее + глагол (инверсия)

exercises.title: few, a few, little, a little
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **few**, **a few**, **little** или **a little** по смыслу.
exercises.example: He has ___ friends here, so he's lonely. → He has **few** friends here.

exercises.title: fewer / less и модели с of
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **fewer**, **less**, **few of**, **a few of** или **a little of**.

items.text: {{Fewer}} people visited the museum this year than last year.
We need {{less}} noise and more concentration in the office.
The journey takes {{less}} than an hour.
Only {{a few of}} the students understood the instructions.
items.hint: few of / a few of / a little of

items.text: Could I have {{a little of}} that sauce, please?
items.hint: few of / a few of / a little of

items.text: {{Few of}} the candidates had any experience.
items.hint: few of / a few of / a little of

items.text: The express checkout is for ten items or {{fewer}}.

items.q: I have ___ money left, so I can't go out tonight.
items.why: Денег почти нет и это проблема → **little**; **a few** не сочетается с неисчисляемым.

items.q: She's new here but has already made ___ friends.
items.why: Положительный смысл («уже завела друзей») + счётное → **a few**.

items.q: ___ is known about the deep ocean floor.
items.why: Знание неисчисляемо, формальный стиль → **Little is known**.

items.q: There were ___ complaints, so the manager was pleased.
items.why: Жалоб почти не было — это радует менеджера; **few** + мн. число.

items.q: We have ___ time before the train leaves; let's get a coffee.
items.why: Время есть, и его хватает на кофе → **a little**.

items.q: There are ___ cars in the city centre than ten years ago.
The ___ money I had was spent on rent.
items.why: **The little + неисчисляемое** = «те немногие деньги, что были».

items.q: Какое предложение значит «почти никто не пришёл»?
Что значит Quite a few people came?
items.why: **Quite a few** = «довольно много», хотя звучит парадоксально.

items.q: Little did she ___ that the meeting had been cancelled.
items.why: После **Little did** подлежащее и глагол в начальной форме: **Little did she know**.

items.q: Few, if ___, of the answers were correct.
items.why: Устойчивое **few, if any** = «мало, если вообще какие-то».
**Few of** требует определителя: **few of the people**.

exercises.title: Перепишите с few / little
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя то, что в скобках.

items.prompt: (Use few) Hardly any tourists visit this island in winter.
answers: Few tourists visit this island in winter.

items.prompt: (Use little) There isn't much hope of a quick agreement.
answers: There is little hope of a quick agreement.
There's little hope of a quick agreement.

items.prompt: (Use quite a few) A fairly large number of residents complained.
(Use fewer) There are not as many students in this class as last year.
answers: There are fewer students in this class than last year.
There are fewer students in this class than there were last year.

items.prompt: (Use a little) We have some milk left, but not much.
answers: We have a little milk left.
We've got a little milk left.
We have got a little milk left.

items.prompt: (Use few of) Hardly any of the employees knew about the plan.
answers: Few of the employees knew about the plan.

exercises.title: Трансформации
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя то, что в скобках.

items.prompt: (Use only a few) Just three or four people replied.
(Use less) There is not so much traffic on Sundays.
answers: There is less traffic on Sundays.

items.prompt: (Start with Little, passive) We know almost nothing about the causes of the disease.
answers: Little is known about the causes of the disease.

items.prompt: (Use a little of) May I try some of your cake? (a small piece)
answers: May I try a little of your cake?

items.prompt: (Use Very few) Almost no one remembers the old language.
answers: Very few people remember the old language.
Very few remember the old language.

items.prompt: (Use a few) She has two or three close friends.
answers: She has a few close friends.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя **few, a few, little, a little, fewer** или **less**.

items.prompt: How much free time do you have these days? Use little or a little.
items.sample: I have little free time these days because of my new project.

items.prompt: Write about your close friends. Use a few.
items.sample: I have a few close friends, and we meet once a month.

items.prompt: What would you like to do less of in your life?
items.sample: I'd like to spend less time on my phone.

items.prompt: What would you like to have fewer of at work or at home?
items.sample: I'd like to have fewer meetings and fewer emails.

items.prompt: Describe a place that few tourists visit.
items.sample: Few tourists visit the old fort near my town, but it is beautiful.

items.prompt: Write about something you know a little about.
items.sample: I know a little about photography, but I'm still a beginner.
